moments.texte: Premier événement de l'histoire de l'UFC : un tournoi à huit, sans catégories de poids. Royce Gracie gagne ses trois combats de la soirée par soumission.
moments.texte_en: The first event in UFC history: an eight-man tournament with no weight classes. Royce Gracie won all three of his fights that night by submission.

preuves.extrait: was the first mixed martial arts event by the Ultimate Fighting Championship

moments.texte: Finale de la première saison de The Ultimate Fighter, première diffusion en direct de l'UFC hors pay-per-view. Griffin gagne aux points ; Bonnar et lui reçoivent tous deux un contrat.
moments.texte_en: The final of the first season of The Ultimate Fighter, the UFC's first live broadcast outside pay-per-view. Griffin won on points; he and Bonnar were both given contracts.

preuves.extrait: first live UFC broadcast on non-pay-per-view television
Both fighters were subsequently awarded UFC contracts

moments.texte: Sorti d'une retraite d'un an, Randy Couture revient chez les lourds et bat le champion Tim Sylvia aux points pour reprendre la ceinture.
moments.texte_en: Coming out of a 12-month retirement, Randy Couture returned to heavyweight and beat champion Tim Sylvia on points to win the title.

moments.texte: Georges St-Pierre était favori à 7 contre 1 : la victoire de Matt Serra, qui lui prend la ceinture des mi-moyens, reste l'une des plus grandes surprises de l'histoire du MMA.
moments.texte_en: Georges St-Pierre was a 7-1 favorite: Matt Serra's win, which took his welterweight title, remains one of the biggest upsets in MMA history.

moments.texte: Premier gala de l'UFC au Moyen-Orient et premier en plein air, à Abu Dhabi : Frankie Edgar détrône B.J. Penn aux points et devient champion des poids légers.
moments.texte_en: The UFC's first event in the Middle East and its first held outdoors, in Abu Dhabi: Frankie Edgar dethroned B.J. Penn on points to become lightweight champion.

preuves.extrait: the first held in the Middle East
first UFC event to be held outdoors

moments.texte: Anderson Silva défend sa ceinture des moyens contre Vitor Belfort et le met KO d'un coup de pied de face, élu KO de la soirée.
moments.texte_en: Anderson Silva defended his middleweight title against Vitor Belfort, knocking him out with a front kick that earned Knockout of the Night.

moments.texte: À 23 ans, Jon Jones arrête Maurício « Shogun » Rua au 3e round et devient le plus jeune champion de l'histoire de l'UFC.
moments.texte_en: At 23, Jon Jones stopped Maurício "Shogun" Rua in the third round to become the youngest champion in UFC history.

preuves.extrait: Won the UFC Light Heavyweight Championship

moments.titre: Chan Sung Jung vs Leonard Garcia
moments.texte: Pour sa revanche, « The Korean Zombie » soumet Leonard Garcia par twister dans la dernière seconde du 2e round : la première victoire par twister de l'histoire de l'UFC.
moments.texte_en: In a rematch, "The Korean Zombie" submitted Leonard Garcia with a twister in the final second of round 2: the first twister finish in UFC history.

preuves.extrait: in the final second of the second round
first time in the history of the UFC that a twister submission finished an opponent

moments.texte: Cinq rounds entre Dan Henderson et Maurício Rua, gagnés aux points par Henderson : combat de la soirée, décrit par beaucoup comme l'un des plus grands de l'histoire de l'UFC.
moments.texte_en: Five rounds between Dan Henderson and Maurício Rua, won on points by Henderson: Fight of the Night, described by many as one of the greatest fights in UFC history.

preuves.extrait: was described by many as one of the greatest fights in UFC history

moments.texte: Premier combat féminin de l'histoire de l'UFC : Ronda Rousey défend son titre des coqs face à Liz Carmouche et gagne par clé de bras au 1er round.
moments.texte_en: The first women's fight in UFC history: Ronda Rousey defended her bantamweight title against Liz Carmouche with a first-round armbar.

preuves.extrait: first-ever women's fight in UFC history
Defended the UFC Women's Bantamweight Championship

moments.texte: Chris Weidman met KO Anderson Silva au 2e round : fin de son règne de sept ans sur les poids moyens et de sa série de 16 victoires à l'UFC.
moments.texte_en: Chris Weidman knocked out Anderson Silva in round 2, ending his seven-year middleweight reign and his 16-fight UFC winning streak.

preuves.extrait: ended Silva's 16-fight winning streak inside the UFC and his seven-year reign as the champion

moments.texte: Devant 56 214 spectateurs à Melbourne, record de l'UFC à l'époque, Holly Holm met KO Ronda Rousey d'un coup de pied à la tête : KO de l'année.
moments.texte_en: In front of 56,214 fans in Melbourne, a UFC record at the time, Holly Holm knocked out Ronda Rousey with a head kick: Knockout of the Year.

preuves.extrait: most attended UFC event in the history of the company at the time, with 56,214
Won the UFC Women's Bantamweight Championship

moments.texte: Le combat dure 13 secondes : la fin la plus rapide de l'histoire des combats pour un titre UFC. Conor McGregor unifie la ceinture des poids plumes.
moments.texte_en: The fight lasted 13 seconds, the fastest finish in UFC title fight history. Conor McGregor unified the featherweight title.

preuves.extrait: fastest finish in UFC title fight history
Won and unified the UFC Featherweight Championship

moments.texte: Appelé pour remplacer Chris Weidman, Michael Bisping met KO le champion Luke Rockhold au 1er round et devient le premier champion britannique de l'UFC.
moments.texte_en: Called in to replace Chris Weidman, Michael Bisping knocked out champion Luke Rockhold in round 1 to become the first British UFC champion.

moments.texte: Premier gala de l'UFC à New York, au Madison Square Garden : Conor McGregor bat Eddie Alvarez et devient le premier combattant de l'UFC à détenir deux ceintures en même temps.
moments.texte_en: The UFC's first event in New York City, at Madison Square Garden: Conor McGregor beat Eddie Alvarez to become the first fighter in UFC history to hold titles in two divisions at once.

preuves.extrait: first UFC event hosted in New York City
first fighter in the promotion's history to hold titles in two divisions simultaneously

moments.texte: Pour le retour de Ronda Rousey après sa défaite contre Holly Holm, Amanda Nunes conserve sa ceinture des coqs en 48 secondes.
moments.texte_en: For Ronda Rousey's return after her loss to Holly Holm, Amanda Nunes kept her bantamweight title in 48 seconds.

preuves.extrait: Defended the UFC Women's Bantamweight Championship

moments.texte: Demetrious Johnson soumet Ray Borg par clé de bras au 5e round : 11e défense de titre d'affilée, record de l'UFC, et soumission de l'année.
moments.texte_en: Demetrious Johnson submitted Ray Borg with an armbar in round 5: his 11th consecutive title defense, a UFC record, and Submission of the Year.

preuves.extrait: Broke the UFC record for the most consecutive title defenses (11)

moments.texte: De retour après quatre ans d'absence, Georges St-Pierre monte chez les moyens et soumet Michael Bisping : il devient le quatrième combattant titré dans deux catégories à l'UFC.
moments.texte_en: Back after four years away, Georges St-Pierre moved up to middleweight and submitted Michael Bisping, becoming the fourth fighter to win UFC titles in two weight classes.

preuves.extrait: fought for the first time in four years
fourth fighter to win titles in different weight classes

moments.texte: Champion des mi-lourds, Daniel Cormier met KO Stipe Miocic au 1er round et devient le deuxième combattant à détenir deux ceintures en même temps, après Conor McGregor.
moments.texte_en: Light heavyweight champion Daniel Cormier knocked out Stipe Miocic in round 1 to become only the second fighter to hold titles in two divisions at once, after Conor McGregor.

preuves.extrait: second fighter to be champion in two divisions simultaneously

moments.texte: Khabib Nurmagomedov soumet Conor McGregor au 4e round et reste invaincu. Le gala devient le pay-per-view de MMA le plus vendu de l'histoire : 2,4 millions d'achats.
moments.texte_en: Khabib Nurmagomedov submitted Conor McGregor in round 4 to stay unbeaten. The event became the best-selling MMA pay-per-view ever: 2.4 million buys.

preuves.extrait: most-bought UFC (and MMA) pay-per-view of all time with a buyrate of 2.4 million

moments.texte: Amanda Nunes met KO Cris Cyborg en 51 secondes et devient la première femme championne dans deux catégories en même temps.
moments.texte_en: Amanda Nunes knocked out Cris Cyborg in 51 seconds to become the first woman to hold titles in two divisions simultaneously.

preuves.extrait: first woman to be champion in two divisions simultaneously
Won the UFC Women's Featherweight Championship

moments.texte: Devant 57 127 spectateurs à Melbourne, record d'affluence de l'UFC, Israel Adesanya met KO Robert Whittaker et unifie la ceinture des moyens.
moments.texte_en: In front of 57,127 fans in Melbourne, a UFC attendance record, Israel Adesanya knocked out Robert Whittaker to unify the middleweight title.

preuves.extrait: broke the attendance record for a UFC event with a total of 57,127
Won and unified the UFC Middleweight Championship

moments.texte: Zhang Weili conserve son titre des poids pailles face à l'ancienne championne Joanna Jędrzejczyk, par décision partagée : un combat considéré par beaucoup comme le plus grand de l'histoire du MMA féminin.
moments.texte_en: Zhang Weili kept her strawweight title against former champion Joanna Jędrzejczyk by split decision, in what many called the greatest fight in women's MMA history.

preuves.extrait: faced former strawweight champion Joanna Jędrzejczyk
considered by many pundits as the greatest fight in women's MMA history
Defended the UFC Women's Strawweight Championship

moments.texte: Khabib Nurmagomedov soumet Justin Gaethje par triangle au 2e round, puis annonce sa retraite dans l'octogone, invaincu en 29 combats.
moments.texte_en: Khabib Nurmagomedov submitted Justin Gaethje with a triangle choke in round 2, then announced his retirement in the cage, unbeaten in 29 fights.

preuves.extrait: he announced his retirement from mixed martial arts
Defended and unified the UFC Lightweight Championship

moments.texte: Troisième combat entre les deux hommes : à la fin du 1er round, Conor McGregor se fracture le tibia, le médecin arrête le combat et Dustin Poirier l'emporte.
moments.texte_en: Their third fight: at the end of round 1 Conor McGregor broke his tibia, the ringside doctor stopped the bout and Dustin Poirier won.

moments.texte: À Singapour, Jiří Procházka soumet Glover Teixeira à 28 secondes de la fin du 5e round et devient champion des mi-lourds : combat de la soirée.
moments.texte_en: In Singapore, Jiří Procházka submitted Glover Teixeira with 28 seconds left in round 5 to become light heavyweight champion: Fight of the Night.

preuves.extrait: Won the UFC Light Heavyweight Championship

moments.texte: À moins d'une minute de la fin du combat, Leon Edwards met KO Kamaru Usman d'un coup de pied à la tête et lui prend la ceinture des mi-moyens.
moments.texte_en: With less than a minute left in the fight, Leon Edwards knocked out Kamaru Usman with a head kick to take his welterweight title.

moments.texte: Les deux hommes s'étaient déjà affrontés deux fois en kickboxing. Au Madison Square Garden, Alex Pereira arrête Israel Adesanya au 5e round et prend la ceinture des moyens.
moments.texte_en: The two had already met twice in kickboxing. At Madison Square Garden, Alex Pereira stopped Israel Adesanya in round 5 to take the middleweight title.

moments.texte: Pour ses débuts chez les lourds, Jon Jones soumet Ciryl Gane par guillotine au 1er round et remporte la ceinture vacante.
moments.texte_en: In his heavyweight debut, Jon Jones submitted Ciryl Gane with a guillotine choke in round 1 to win the vacant title.

preuves.extrait: Won the vacant UFC Heavyweight Championship

moments.texte: Battu par Alex Pereira deux fois en kickboxing puis à l'UFC 281, Israel Adesanya le met KO au 2e round et reprend la ceinture des moyens.
moments.texte_en: Beaten by Alex Pereira twice in kickboxing and then at UFC 281, Israel Adesanya knocked him out in round 2 to regain the middleweight title.

preuves.extrait: Pereira captured the title by fifth-round knockout

moments.texte: Invaincu, Ilia Topuria met KO Alexander Volkanovski au 2e round et devient champion des poids plumes.
moments.texte_en: Unbeaten Ilia Topuria knocked out Alexander Volkanovski in round 2 to become featherweight champion.

moments.texte: Pour la ceinture symbolique « BMF », Max Holloway met KO Justin Gaethje à une seconde de la fin du 5e round : la fin la plus tardive de l'histoire de l'UFC, à égalité.
moments.texte_en: For the symbolic "BMF" title, Max Holloway knocked out Justin Gaethje with one second left in round 5: tied for the latest finish in UFC history.

preuves.extrait: Tied for latest finish in UFC history

moments.texte: Au Sphere, près de Las Vegas, Merab Dvalishvili bat Sean O'Malley aux points et devient champion des poids coqs.
moments.texte_en: At Sphere, near Las Vegas, Merab Dvalishvili beat Sean O'Malley on points to become bantamweight champion.

preuves.extrait: at Sphere in Paradise, Nevada , part of the Las Vegas Valley

moments.texte: Sur la pelouse sud de la Maison-Blanche, premier événement sportif professionnel organisé à la résidence présidentielle, Justin Gaethje bat Ilia Topuria et unifie la ceinture des poids légers.
moments.texte_en: On the South Lawn of the White House, the first professional sporting event staged at the presidential residence, Justin Gaethje beat Ilia Topuria to unify the lightweight title.

preuves.extrait: The South Lawn of the White House held the first professional sporting event staged at the presidential residence
Won and unified the UFC Lightweight Championship
